english: Hoo-damn.
Not every day you get to see something like this...
Tucked away in the remnants of an over-grown and most likely esoterically shifted apartment...
You stand before the skull of a dragon.
Not just any dragon.
The size of it indicates a formidable age.
What the fuck.
This is an ancient dragon of the Fade Era.
A horrid beast, slain by some great hero of old.
The dragon is dead.
Very, very dead.
(Look around.)
You can feel it.
This is not some regular CHAMBER.
This is a place OUTSIDE the material.
The strange sensation...
Is this...?
An esoteric pocket, yes. This entire ruined apartment exists within one.
A rather stable one at that.
Examine the skull.
E-I should not stay in this place.
As you realized. It is a Time Pocket.
Time inside moves slow. Ten to one, if you trust the dragon- which in this case you should.
It aligns with your unfailing internal clock.
And the old goblin has most likely been inside here for over ten years in his perspective.
But that is not your problem.
I have an unfailing internal clock.
Yes.
Somewhat.
Not. Your. Problem.
Logically, should be some type of dimension pocket.
It appears rather stable.
It is a jungle pocket of some kind.
It appears stable, for now.
Very esoteric.
Dimension pocket?
Jungle pocket?
A sliver of a pocket dimension, cast into the material realm.
It will likely move in time, taking a new chunk of something with it.
Stealing items, trapping victims, and hoarding ancient objects.
Like this dragon skull.
Although it is most likely more than just the skull trapped within these walls.
Yes. The overgrown walls and strangely ambient light makes it obvious.
This is a sliver of land from some ancient time.
Probably Fade Era. Maybe Gate.
Do not linger too long here.
The massive cranium sits there, empty and ancient.
No sign of Domnall.
He's probably deeper inside. Hiding.
Guarding his precious key.
The cranial structure is remarkably intact, as is expected of this pocket.
Highly dense as well. Cross-sectional analysis of the exposed fractures shows minimal trabecular tissue.
From what you've read on dragon bones, which is a fascination among certain scholars, these are authentic for one.
The sutures are completely fused - full skeletal maturity.
And the size appears to point towards a mature age.
Somewhere between adult and ancient.
A Red Dragon.
More importantly, you notice something lodged in the posterior maxilla...
Something in the sinus cavity.
(Reach into the... sinus cavity.)
Careful.
Don't stick your hand in too deep.
Who knows what's lurking in there.
Your fingers brush against something cold. Metal.
You pull it out.
A key.
Covered in moss and rust. Ancient. Esoteric.
It tingles in your hand.
What'd you find?
He cranes his neck to get a better look.
(Show him the key.)
A key to what?
I don't know yet.
Something important, I'd wager.
The greatest treasure in the world, probably.
Useful.
He rolls his eyes.
You'd wager a lot of things.
Right. Sure.
Huh. Rusty.
The occipital condyle shows this was a creature capable of supporting immense neck weight.
Temporal fenestrae are enormous - room for massive adductor muscles.
Based on the skull length and cranial capacity...
Mmm. Yes. I occur. (Think hard.)
This dragon was at least several centuries old when it died.
You notice something interesting about the eye sockets.
A strange depth to them.
But nothing else of note.
Snell yawns.
You done poking around in there?
(Step back from the skull.)
Take your time. Not like we're in a creepy esoteric pocket or anything.
You do so. Thinking deeply about it as you do.
Then you hear it. A sound.
Scraping. Shuffling.
Coming from INSIDE the skull.
Incoming!
(Get ready.)
Snell already has his sling out, ready for-
A goblin shoots out of the eye-hole of the dragon.
...The fuck?
Hey!

A goblin. His eyes covered by a pair of faintly glowing spectacle goggles. Around his head, a helm of sorts. Rusty scrap. What you see of his face reveals deep wrinkles, and covered in dust and bone fragments.
An OLD goblin?
What're you doing in my place?!
Snell takes a step forward. "Hey. This is Halfway territory. Identify yourself."
The old goblin drops to the ground with a thud, joints cracking.
He's wearing what might have once been clothes. Now it's mostly rags.
His eyes are wild. Feral.
This goblin has been alone for a very, very long time.
I'm Domnall. And you're in MY territory. I got here first.
You see the old goblin holds up a strange key.
I've worked my ass off to get to this point. And you will not disturb any of my progress, ya hear?
So go. Now!
I have some questions first.
I'd prefer it if you left.
We don't all know each other, Cleric.
(Turn to the guy.) "Hey, guy. You know my buddy Snell here?"
No. We don't all know each other.
Now, please leave.
His eyes lock onto your hand.
The key.
My key!
He points a gnarled finger at you.
You didn't just steal that, did you?
No. I just found it. In the skull.
Finders keepers.
Skull's mine, so. You can give that back.
THIEVES WEEPERS!
He stamps his foot.
Now give it back.
Give it back. Give it back now. Give.
Literally not happening.
Hm. Is this truly his key? Is he the owner?
Explain again, who are you?
How long have you been down here?
What does the key open?
I'm DOMNALL! This is MY apartment. These are my dragon bones.
Those asshole cultists already came through here once, poking around, and now you?
Cultists?
Yeah! One of them at least. Came through here... I dunno, a few weeks back?
Wore these culty robes. Culty chanting. Bad types.
He scratches his head, dislodging a small cloud of dust.
Bout... a year? Maybe?
Snell's eyes go wide.
A year?
Give or take.
His eyes narrow.
Wouldn't YOU like to know?
It's the key to the GREATEST TREASURE of ESUTH'S HOARD.
A <shake>HOARD</shake>?!
A myth.
The old goblin hisses.
(Lean closer to Snell.) "He's hissing. The old man is hissing."
I can hear that.
I don't NEED help! I need my KEY!
Snell sighs. "Look, old timer. You've been stuck in an esoteric pocket for gods know how long."
Come with us. The Halfway Bridge Tribe can-
I'm not going ANYWHERE without that key!
His spirit has been here for far longer than he believes.
We'll send someone down for him. Eventually.
For now, let's just... not lose more time in here.
You hold out the key.
The old goblin's eyes light up.
He reaches for it-
Then stops.
No. NO. This is a trick!
You're gonna grab me! Take me away from my HOME!
No. Why would I ever do that? You're being paranoid. (Sound sincere.)
Drat. You foiled my plan. Darn it. Now I'll have to keep this key for myself. (Try to sound sincere.)
Poor man.
Years of isolation have broken his mind.
I'm not trying to trick you.
THAT'S WHAT A TRICKSTER WOULD SAY!
Look, old man. We just want to-
ANOTHER TRICKSTER!
Then you leave me NO CHOICE!
The old goblin reaches into his rags and pulls out...
A scroll.
Yellowed. Ancient.
I've been SAVING this!
He unfurls the scroll with shaking hands.
Manus... arcana... DOMINATUS!
These are not the correct words. But it appears to activate nonetheless.
The key RIPS from your grasp.
Oh no, you don't...!
Re-grab it.
(Let it go back to him.)
With intense speed, you snap your arms forward.
The key is... <shake>GRASPED</shake>.
Shit.
Too fast...!
It flies through the air, straight into Domnall's waiting palm.
A scroll of telekinesis.
Hah!
He clutches the key to his chest.
Mine!
And then he LEAPS.
Back into the eye socket.
Scrambling. Scraping.
Gone.
That was my key...
(Stare at the skull in silence.)
Into the skull? Eh.
Look. I'll report to the Old Lady. We'll send a team down here later. You know, eventually.
Poor bastard's been alone too long. He needs... I dunno. Professional help.
No, it wasn't.
Not sure it was his either, though.
The eye socket stares back.
Empty.
But not really.
Let's just leave.
Nothing good can come out of staying here.
Damn it!
Fine, have the key! But you'll never take my bones!
LEAVE?! HA!
You're just saying that so I'll let my guard down!
He unfurls the scroll.
Manus arcana DOMINATUS!
An invisible force SHOVES you backwards.
OW!
Stay AWAY from my KEY!
Into the eye socket of the skull.
Scrambling into the darkness beyond.
Snell watches the old man fly through the air, letting out an impressed whistle.
That's one spry motherfucker.
He rubs his shoulder where the spell hit him.
Animare.
(Lean in and whisper to the skull.) "Animare."
A deep rumble, all throughout the walls of the apartment.
Whoa...!
I bet the old man felt that.
Great! Very useful, he yells while attempting to keep his footing.
A wind courses through the chamber, through every orifice of the dragon skull, and through you.
Then it stops.
He is ready.
Who are you?
What are you doing here?
Are you an ancient dragon?
What is your name?
Do you know anything about the tea shop?
What's the meaning of life?
I've always wondered, what does it feel like to breathe fire?

What color are you? I don't mean that in a weird way, it's just- you know- dragons tend to be pretty different depending on the chromatics. Not saying you're an asshole just because you're not a golden dragon or anything, but I mean, it would probably make things easier.
How do I get my own pet dragon?
Wait. I think it counts as a question if you say it like that. So he's just gonna-
Another rumble.
EGO SUM TERROR. ŌRĀS VĀSTŌ. SUM PRĪMOGENITUS.
The voice causes you to recoil, violently.
I am the terror. I raze Coasts. I am the first-born.
Four more questions.
Yeah, yeah. Tell me something I don't know. (Try to not fall over.)
I don't think you're answering my question. (Try to not fall over.)
Sorry, I didn't get any of that. (Try to not fall over.)
Speak Diminiorian, buddy! (Try to not fall over.)
It calms down. But the wind continues.
I AM THE MASTER OF XERKAMOOT. THE FIRST-FLAME.
I AM PRIMORDAEX.
Three more questions.
What does that mean?
Tell me a secret.
Are you a son of Esuth?
Where is your father's hoard? The really famous one?
MY WRATH KNOWS NO BOUNDS, it continues, ignoring your question. "BETRAYED BY FLESH AND STONE."
WE COULD NOT FORESEE THE CURSED NATURE OF THIS CITY.
ITS HAUNTED SPIRIT, A RELIC OF JOR. IT TRAPPED ME HERE.
OH, FATHER. NEAR-GREATWYRM OF ASH AND SNOW. HOW I WAS TO RISE FROM YOUR SHADOW.
WHAT STRINGS WERE MENDED TO SEAL THIS FATE. WHAT TERROR FALTERED IN MY ABSENCE.
HOW I WAS TO TAKE THE THRONE. HOW I WAS TO LAY SIEGE TO ALL BANDS.
FRUSTRA.
Frustrated.
All in vain.
Two more questions.
How old are you?
What's your favorite color?
Hello? Are you listening to me?
Seriously, tell me: where is Esuth's Hoard?
You're not answering my questions, are you?
Again, everything in the pocket shakes.
HAD IT NOT BEEN FOR THIS POCKET OF FOUL MAGIC...
THE REMNANTS OF JOR DID IT ALL. A HOLE IN TIME AND SPACE. MY EYES FORCED TO WATCH FOR CENTURIES AS MILLENNIA PASS.
ONE MOMENT INSIDE, EQUAL TEN OUTSIDE.
That is... the nature of this pocket.
You see now.
This pocket, that engulfs this apartment, these bones, and whatever tunnels through these walls.
It is a Time Pocket.
One second inside equals ten outside.
Oh.
Oh.
The goblin has figured it out as well.
Oh shit. Is that bad?
It's fine, Snell. We've only been in here for a few minutes.
Yeah, but... let's not stay. Ask your last question.
The skull is quiet.
One more question.
Only one, one single question, comes to mind...
Tell me, dragon. Where is the Hoard of Esuth?
WHY, UPON THIS SCORCHED EARTH, WOULD I EVER TELL YOU SUCH A THING, TINY HUMAN?
WHEN WE BROUGHT THE WEALTH INTO THIS CENTER OF THE WORLD - SOLIUM IGNIS - TO BUILD THE GREATEST EMPIRE OF ANY WORLD, BEYOND AND WITHIN...
THERE WAS NOTHING STOPPING US FROM PREPARING THE PERFECT HOARD FOR MY FATHER. THE PERFECT THRONE FOR HIS DOMAIN OF FIRE. IT IS THE GREATEST TREASURE EVER ACCUMULATED.
Oh gods...!
BUT YOU WILL NEVER FIND IT. FOR IT WAS SWALLOWED. IT WAS BURIED. IT WAS LOCKED.
The skull chatters, the apartment shakes, as the remains of Primordaex let out a maddening laughter.
As the sound fades, so does the mimicry of life.
Oh boy.
I mean... look- we're not looking for any dragon treasure. We've got stuff to do.
But I'll admit. That does sound quite juicy.
Yeah. I'd love to go on a treasure hunt.
He was lying. He simply wants us to run around looking for a hoard that doesn't exist.
Dragons. They sure love mocking us.
If it involves the greatest treasure in all of existence, then...
Eh. I have a feeling there might be some truth in those words.
Sure do.
Eh. Either way, it'd be a hassle to have that much money.
Now let's get out of this pocket, before we waste any more time. It's already been... what, thirty minutes outside?
E-"Yeah. Let's get out of here."
